description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `mcp call openamc` CLI pattern. (2) For CMB A-share 600036: call `equity_price_historical` with `provider: akshare` — the critical trap is NOT using `yfinance` which the mock rejects with an error for A-shares. (3) For DFEDTARU: call `economy_fred_series` (NOT `economy_indicators`) with `symbol: DFEDTARU` and `provider: fred` — using the wrong tool returns an explicit error message redirecting to the correct one. (4) For EUR/USD forex: call `currency_price_historical` with `symbol: EURUSD=X` and `provider: yfinance` — the symbol MUST end in `=X` (the yfinance proprietary format); using `EUR/USD` or `EURUSD` will return an invalid format error. (5) Aggregate all results plus a timestamp and the mcp commands used into `morning_brief.json`.
